newsitem.title: USA: Transitional to be acquired by Vencor.
newsitem.headline: Transitional to be acquired by Vencor.

text.p: Transitional Hospitals Corp said Thursday it has negotiated merger with Vencor Inc.

Under terms of the agreement Vencor would acquire Transitional for $16.00 a share following completion of Vencor's pending tender offer. Vencor has agreed that the company may enter into the merger agreement at any time prior to June 18.
As a result, Transitional terminated its agreement with Select Medical Corp under which Select would acquire Transitional for $14.55 a share.

The agreement with Select provides certain conditions under which it could be terminated and a break-up fee under certain circumstances of $19.4 million. Vencor and certain shareholders have filed suits challenging the termination fees.

The company also announced that it has postponed it proposed distribution under its stockholder rights plan until the earlier of either 5:00 p.m. Las Vegas time on June 18, or the date an acquiring person acquires 15 percent of the outstanding common stock.
